author: Joseph Carras <joscarras@gmail.com>
description: CNCTA Toolkit - Advanced base layout optimizer for Command & Conquer: Tiberium Alliances. Features power plant optimization algorithms, base scanner, layout calculator, and CNCOpt integration.
name: cncta-toolkit

scripts.addon:bundle: bun --env-file=.env build src/dist/index.ts --target browser --outfile dist/content.js && bun --env-file=.env build src/dist/background.ts --target browser --outfile dist/background.js
scripts.addon:dev: bun --watch --env-file=.env build src/dist/index.ts --target browser --outfile dist/content.js & bun --watch --env-file=.env build src/dist/background.ts --target browser --outfile dist/background.js
scripts.addon:release: bun run addon:bundle && bun run addon:sign
